summary.zh: 传统上将早王朝/古王国政治中心置于上下埃及交汇处；Wilkinson 与 Bard 在国家出现与区域城市化讨论中定位孟斐斯——未登记专址现代发掘总报前不编造出土清单。
summary.en: Conventionally the Early Dynastic / Old Kingdom political center at the Upper–Lower Egypt junction; oriented in Wilkinson and Bard — no invented find lists without a registered Memphis monograph.
